permissions.name: Read Documents
permissions.description: Allows viewing documents, uploaded PDFs, signature status and the signature log

permissions.name: Manage Documents
permissions.description: Allows creating documents, uploading PDFs, routing them for approval, running signing batches, and configuring templates, approval chains, signature policies, signing rails, stamp placement and retention rules

permissions.name: Sign Documents
permissions.description: Allows applying an eID / DAN / HSM digital signature or rejecting a document
